---
title: "Electronic Frontiers Australia Fundraising Drive"
date: "2010-03-22"
categories: ["Media"]
---

[Electronic Frontiers Australia](http://www.efa.org.au/support2010/ "Electronic Frontiers Australia") has been campaigning for online civil liberties since 1994 and is currently on the frontline of the battle against the federal government’s internet filtering regime.  They are currently conducting a fundraising drive and I hope IE readers will join me in making a [donation](http://www.efa.org.au/support2010/ "donation").  EFA Board members are not paid for their efforts, so you can be sure funds will be used for campaigning purposes.
